description: Implementation of a Text-to-Speech (TTS) service using Gradium's websocket API, including connection management, message handling, and TTS streaming.

classes.name: GradiumTTSService
classes.description: A Python class implementing a TTS service using Gradium's websocket API, supporting connection management, message processing, and streaming speech synthesis.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: set_model
methods.description: Updates the TTS model used by the service.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates service settings and reconnects if the voice ID has changed.

methods.name: _build_msg
methods.description: Constructs a JSON message for the Gradium API with the given text.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Establishes websocket connection to start TTS streaming.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the TTS service and disconnects.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing TTS operation and disconnects.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes websocket connection and starts message reception.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes websocket connection and cleans up tasks.

methods.name: _connect_websocket
methods.description: Connects to the Gradium websocket API with configured settings.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket
methods.description: Closes websocket connection and resets state.

methods.name: _get_websocket
methods.description: Returns the active websocket connection or raises an exception if not connected.

methods.name: flush_audio
methods.description: Sends an end-of-stream message to flush pending audio.

methods.name: _receive_messages
methods.description: Processes incoming websocket messages, handling audio, text, end of stream, and error messages.

methods.name: push_frame
methods.description: Pushes a frame downstream and handles end-of-turn conditions.

methods.name: run_tts
methods.description: Streams generated speech frames from input text using Gradium's websocket API.
